label: South Africa: Cape + Kruger
summary: 3n Cape Peninsula (penguins, fynbos, Table Mtn), 3n self-drive southern Kruger in SANParks camps. Christmas in Kruger. Dec 27 exit via MQP, NBO 22:05.
verdict: Most varied stopover: Cape penguins/seals/fynbos plus cheap Kruger self-drive (rhino, wild dog, leopard). Priciest too (~+$2,400 pp, 3 peak regional flights); overlaps Kenya safari, and holiday camps may be full, so check SANParks first.

safety.advisory_level: US State Dept Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (May 27 2025; still L2 as of Mar 2026; re-check travel.state.gov)
safety.summary: Advisory: crime, terrorism, unrest, kidnapping. Real tourist risk: violent crime (carjacking, smash-and-grab, mugging) in cities, at lights, highways after dark. Route (Gardens, Peninsula, Kruger, daytime N4, airports) low risk with care; in Kruger wildlife, speed, heat matter; low-moderate malaria.
precautions: No driving after dark outside park; obey Kruger gate times (late fines).
Nothing visible in car; doors locked, windows up at lights (smash-and-grab).
Cape Town after dark: Uber, not walking. Avoid CBD/Long St late.
ATMs in malls/airport only; shield PIN.
Cape Point/Boulders: no visible food, windows shut (baboons).
Kruger: stay in car except designated spots. Walks/night drives SANParks-guided only.
Malaria prophylaxis (Dec = rainy; needed for Kenya anyway), DEET, long sleeves at dusk.
Table Mtn: check cableway (wind closures); don't hike alone.
Dec 27: N4 Komatipoort-Nelspruit daylight only, no roadside stops. Separate tickets: keep 5h JNB buffer.

visa: US passport: visa-free 90 days. 2 blank pages, 30+ days validity after exit (bring 6 mo). No yellow fever cert from US. Kenya eTA as planned.
weather_dec: Cape Town: peak summer, dry, sunny, ~16-27 C, very windy ('Cape Doctor' can close cableway), light till ~20:00. Kruger: wet season, ~20-33 C (sometimes 38 C+), green, afternoon storms. Baby animals, great birding; game more spread out.
highlights: Boulders Beach penguin colony: boardwalks, near-certain sightings
Cape Point/Good Hope: fynbos, bontebok, eland, baboons, ostrich, cliffs
Chapman's Peak Drive; Table Mtn cableway peninsula views
Southern Kruger Big 5 self-drive: H4-1, H4-2/S28 (rhino, leopard, lion, wild dog)
SANParks sunset/night drive: only way to see Kruger nocturnals
Christmas at Lower Sabie: hippos, elephants on Sabie River below deck
Two biomes Kenya lacks: Cape Floral Kingdom, Cape marine life
drawbacks: Priciest: ~+$2,400 pp over $1,500 base; 3 Christmas-fare regional flights (CPT-SZK, MQP-JNB, JNB-NBO).
Kruger = more savanna before 19n Kenya safari. Extras: rhino, wild dog.
Peak + SA school holidays: camps, Airlink, cars sell out. Fallback: Marloth/Komatipoort/Hazyview, ~R1,400-2,000/room.
Dec 27 long: ~2.5h road, 1h flight, ~5h JNB wait, KQ763 to NBO 22:05. Dec 28 rest.
Skukuza-JNB (4Z862 ~13:35, 4Z866 ~14:35) too late for KQ763 17:00; separate tickets, no protection. Hence MQP.
Cheaper (~+$1,300 pp): Kruger only. TK to JNB, airport night, 4.5h to Malelane, 4n Kruger, back, KQ763. No Cape; two 5h drives.
Upgrade: 2n private Sabi Sand/Timbavati lodge (open-vehicle, off-road leopard), ~$450-1,000 pppn Dec.
Fares/times estimates: Dec TK/Airlink/KQ fares unseen; Airlink times from trackers. 2026/27 fee (from Nov 1) unread; assume R602 +5-10%.

legs.detail: Turkish TK10, LAX ~19:45 to IST ~19:00 (+1). Winter schedule from Oct 25; reconfirm.
Turkish TK44, IST 01:55 to CPT 11:50 (daily, winter from Oct 26 2026). ~7h IST layover night of Dec 20; IGA hotel or lounge.
Rental car via M3, Muizenberg to Boulders (Simon's Town), then Cape Point.
Back via Chapman's Peak (toll ~R65/car), Camps Bay. Home before dark.
Airlink 4Z651, CPT 10:30 to Skukuza ~12:55 (E190, daily; reconfirm). Return Cape car at CPT. Avis one-way Skukuza to MQP.
H4-1 along Sabie River, best leopard road. 50 km/h on tar.
Leave at gate opening (04:30 Dec). H4-2 to Crocodile Bridge (34 km, ~1h game drive), N4 via Komatipoort, Malelane to MQP (~1.5h). Drop Avis car.
Airlink 4Z840, MQP 10:50 to JNB 11:45 (tracker data; earlier ~08:10, 09:20). Separate ticket from KQ; ~5h buffer.
Kenya Airways KQ763, JNB 17:00 to NBO 22:05 (daily; 787/737). Recheck bags, international terminal.
Pre-booked night guesthouse transfer (light traffic). Sleep; Dec 28 rest day.

itinerary.title: Depart LAX
itinerary.details: Sat evening. TK10 ~19:45, ~13h to IST. Sleep on plane.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cape Town, rest
itinerary.details: Land 11:50. Rental car, 30 min to Gardens. Nap. Optional V&A Waterfront/Bo-Kaap. Early night.

itinerary.title: Penguins + Cape Point
itinerary.details: Leave 07:30. 1.25h to Boulders, penguins pre-crowds. Cape Point: bontebok, eland, ostrich, baboons, fynbos walk to Good Hope. Back via Chapman's Peak ~1.5h. ~3h driving, split.
itinerary.meals: Packed lunch (eat inside the car because of baboons); fish and chips at Kalk Bay or Hout Bay

itinerary.title: Table Mtn + Kirstenbosch
itinerary.details: Light day. Early cableway if calm (book online; wind shifts to afternoon). Dassies, views. Afternoon Kirstenbosch (15 min): proteas, sugarbirds. <1h driving. Pack.
itinerary.meals: Self-cater breakfast; picnic at Kirstenbosch; dinner out

itinerary.title: Fly to Kruger, Christmas Eve
itinerary.details: Return car CPT. 4Z651 10:30, Skukuza ~12:55. Avis car, check in. 15:00-18:30 Sabie River loop (elephant, hippo, kudu). Optional ~3h sunset drive. Gates close ~18:30.
itinerary.meals: Plane snack; Skukuza restaurant; braai (barbecue) dinner

itinerary.title: Christmas on the Sabie
itinerary.details: Gate 04:30. Dawn H4-1 to Lower Sabie (43 km, 3-4h, leopard). Midday pool/deck. Afternoon S28/H4-2 (rhino, lion, wild dog). Sunset Dam. ~4-5h driving, two sessions.
itinerary.meals: Packed breakfast; Christmas lunch at the camp restaurant; braai dinner

itinerary.title: Full Kruger day
itinerary.details: Optional SANParks morning walk (~3-4h) OR H4-2 toward Crocodile Bridge/Gomondwane. Siesta through heat/storms. Short drive or night drive (civets, hyenas, bushbabies). Pack, early bed.

itinerary.title: Kruger to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Leave 04:30-05:00. ~1h H4-2 to Crocodile Bridge, ~1.5h N4 to MQP, drop car. 4Z840 10:50, JNB 11:45. Recheck bags, lunch, ~5h spare. KQ763 17:00, NBO 22:05. eTA, 45 min to Karen. Sleep.
itinerary.meals: Packed breakfast; JNB lunch; dinner on plane

lodging.name: Once in Cape Town (private en-suite double)
lodging.includes: Private en-suite, Wi-Fi, breakfast (often incl.), parking
lodging.why: Safe, walkable, restaurants, Uber. 10 min to cableway/Kirstenbosch, 25-30 min to airport. Among cheapest decent peak private rooms.
lodging.alternatives: Ashanti Lodge Gardens; Never@Home Green Point; Muizenberg/Kalk Bay guesthouse or Airbnb (near penguins, ~R1,800-2,500/night)

lodging.name: Skukuza Rest Camp (bungalow BD2/BA2)
lodging.includes: En-suite double, fridge, AC, braai stand. Conservation fee extra (R602 pp/day through Oct 2026; 2026/27 rate from Nov 1).
lodging.why: 10 min from airport, on river, restaurant, shop, sunset drives from camp. Kruger starts on landing.
lodging.alternatives: Skukuza safari tent (~R1,300-1,600); Hazyview guesthouses outside Paul Kruger gate

lodging.name: Lower Sabie Rest Camp (bungalow, river view if possible)
lodging.includes: En-suite double, AC, fridge; river units have Sabie deck. Restaurant, pool. Conservation fee extra.
lodging.why: Top game density (rhino, lion, wild dog, elephant, hippo). Good Christmas spot; nearest major camp to Crocodile Bridge for Dec 27.
lodging.alternatives: Crocodile Bridge camp; Marloth Park/Komatipoort guesthouses (~R1,400-2,000/room) if full. Both nearer N4 to MQP.

2026 bungalows est. ~R2,000-2,400/unit (old sheets R1,310-1,815). Outside-park fallback similar.

booking.task: Check SANParks: Skukuza Dec 24, Lower Sabie Dec 25-26 (sanparks.org, +27 12 428 9111). If full: Crocodile Bridge/Marloth/Komatipoort + waitlists. Before flights.
Price/buy Turkish multi-city (LAX-CPT Dec 19, TK10+TK44 01:55; NBO-LAX Jan 16 TK608/TK9). Compare vs base ticket + separate trip.
Book Airlink 4Z651 CPT-SZK (Dec 24), 4Z840 MQP-JNB 10:50 or earlier (Dec 27, not afternoon SZK-JNB), KQ763 JNB-NBO (Dec 27).
Rental cars: CPT airport Dec 21-24; Avis Skukuza-MQP one-way Dec 24-27. Automatics sell out.
Reserve sunset/night drive (Skukuza Dec 24 or Lower Sabie Dec 26) + optional morning walk.
Book Cape Town guesthouse, Nairobi Dec 27 night + transfer. Travel clinic: malaria prophylaxis (covers Kenya).
Cableway tickets online (flex wind backup day). Confirm 2026/27 SANParks fees, Airlink/KQ times. Offline maps. Kenya eTA x2.

safety_short: Real risk: violent crime (carjacking, mugging), cities, after dark. Cape route and Kruger low-risk with care.
